__NOTOC__{{NPC infobox | image = [[Image:Luxon monk.jpg|150px]] | level = 10 | affiliation = Luxons | type = Human | campaign = Core | campaign2 = Factions | service = Faction rewards{{pipe}}Faction reward }} The [[Luxon Scavenger]] allows the player to cash in [[Luxon faction]] for [[faction rewards]]. Players can trade 5,000 Luxon faction for 1 [[Jadeite Shard]] or 1,000 Luxon faction for 1 [[Passage Scroll to the Deep]]. [[Level]] 20 [[roleplaying character]]s can also trade 3,000 Luxon faction for a Luxon skill. 5,000 Luxon faction can be donated to your guild. Trading in Luxon faction causes a player's [[account]] to lose the same amount of [[Kurzick faction]] until the account has 0 Kurzick faction. Every time Luxon faction is traded or donated this way, the same amount of faction points go towards your Luxon [[allegiance rank]] title track. ==Locations== *[[Core]] **[[The Battle Isles]] ***{{NPC location|Guild hall}} (Luxon [[alliance]]) *[[Factions]] **[[Echovald Forest]] ***{{NPC location|Grenz Frontier (Luxon)}} ***{{NPC location|The Ancestral Lands (Luxon)}} **[[The Jade Sea]] ***{{NPC location|Cavalon}} ***{{NPC location|Eredon Terrace}} ***{{NPC location|Etnaran Keys (Luxon)}} ***{{NPC location|Fort Aspenwood (Luxon)}} ***{{NPC location|Kaanai Canyon (Luxon)}} ***{{NPC location|Leviathan Pits}} ***{{NPC location|Saltspray Beach (Luxon)}} ***{{NPC location|The Jade Quarry (Luxon)}} == Skills offered == {{Skill trainer list | w = * [[Image:"Save Yourselves!"
